name: Wizard only for dependent steps
problem: Creation flows become wizards by default even when steps are independent, adding friction without dependency payoff.
worksWhen: Later steps require confirmation or data from earlier ones
The flow shows step count and allows back navigation except for irreversible commits
failsWhen: All settings could be completed safely on one form
Back navigation discards prior input or steps feel irreversible without reason

name: Just-in-time permission requests
problem: Mobile and creation onboarding ask for permissions before the user understands why, increasing denial rates.
worksWhen: The permission prompt appears at the moment the capability is needed
The preceding UI explains the value of granting access in concrete terms
failsWhen: Permissions are stacked into an early onboarding checklist
The product asks for access without linking it to an immediate action

name: Choose library type before path
problem: Library setup asks for folder paths before the user commits to a content type, which forces rework when the type changes options.
worksWhen: Type selection comes first and orients subsequent path and scanner options
Advanced options stay collapsed until the type is chosen
failsWhen: Path entry precedes type and makes type-dependent options feel arbitrary
All library options appear at equal weight regardless of type

name: Persist library filters across sessions
problem: High-frequency library filters reset every visit, forcing repeated taps on mobile and dense launchers.
worksWhen: Filter and sort selection survive session boundaries
The default filter still remains easy to clear or override
failsWhen: Users must reselect the same filter every return visit
Persisted filters hide important new content without a reset path

name: Pinned shortcuts above the main list
problem: Dense libraries bury the few highest-frequency destinations inside the same scroll as everything else.
worksWhen: A pinned or shortcut tier sits above the main list for frequent destinations
The main list remains complete and searchable underneath
failsWhen: Every item competes at the same hierarchy level
Pinned rows become another unmanaged favorites dump

name: Keep destructive actions in overflow
problem: Library and setup surfaces place delete, reset, or overwrite actions next to the primary create CTA, increasing mis-taps.
worksWhen: Destructive actions sit in a secondary overflow away from the primary CTA
Import and export remain first-class but still separated from delete
failsWhen: Delete and create share the same visual weight
Destructive actions appear as unlabeled icons near the main action

name: Workspace picker before naming
problem: Creation forms ask for names and details before the user chooses the permission or workspace context those details belong to.
worksWhen: Workspace or destination picker is the first consequential step
Naming and templates appear only after permission context is clear
failsWhen: Users name an object and then discover they created it in the wrong workspace
Permission context is buried below advanced settings

name: Essential versus advanced option tiers
problem: Library and setup forms expose every option at equal weight, delaying the first successful configuration.
worksWhen: Essential options are visible by default and advanced options stay collapsed
Type or mode selection determines which advanced options appear
failsWhen: Experts and novices face the same dense option wall
Advanced options appear before the user has chosen a type or mode

name: Density toggle for high-volume libraries
problem: Media and content libraries lock users into one density even when collections range from dozens to tens of thousands of items.
worksWhen: Users can switch density without leaving the library surface
Default grouping still uses a natural temporal or categorical dimension
failsWhen: High-volume collections only offer one cramped or one sparse view
Density changes reset filters or scroll position unexpectedly

name: Create and open existing as equal entries
problem: Launcher empty and first-run surfaces bury open-existing under create, even when many users already have content elsewhere.
worksWhen: Create new and open existing are equally prominent
Import or attach existing paths are not nested under a single create button
failsWhen: Open existing is hidden behind create or overflow
Users with existing work are forced through a blank create funnel
